This is a clear, specific, and verifiable software requirement related to data recording within the mission log. The full SRS context in section 7 Data Requirements (SFMC-REQ-044 to SFMC-REQ-047) supports the existence and purpose of the mission log and its contents, including event times. The requirement is well-written, unambiguous, and consistent with the SRS scope. No undefined terms or vague criteria are present. There is no explicit software allocation detail beyond the mission log maintenance, but the requirement is clearly software-related. No applicable SWE linkage is justified from the supplied NPR passages, as none explicitly address mission log event time recording. The Handbook guidance supports the clarity and completeness of such requirements but does not mandate specific SWE references here. Therefore, the requirement is acceptable with no quality issues."
